description: Permissions granted to the main window. Least privilege runs both ways: every entry here has a caller, and every plugin registered in lib.rs that the frontend calls has an entry. A plugin registered without its permission fails at runtime, not at build time, so the second half is the one that bites.

permissions.comment: open_path checks the path against Entry::Path scope entries only; the URL entries from allow-default-urls never match a path, so without this the system-app buttons in file-preview.tsx always fail. The vault directory is chosen at runtime, so no narrower static scope is possible here.

The port must be written explicitly: an unspecified port in a URLPattern matches only the scheme default, so `http://**` would reject Ollama on :11434, a local MinerU on :8000 and every self-hosted gateway on a non-default port.
